Maya Patel: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. Dropping a concise list of clarifications, owners, and links. Please react :white_check_mark: when you take ownership.

Dan Wu: Please confirm the timeline for the Dedicated GA again? Need week numbers for planning.

Maya Patel: Dedicated GA targeted mid-April (week of Apr 14). Private VPC beta targeted early May (week of May 5). On-prem pilot late May. I'll put exact weeks in the roadmap doc.

Priya Singh: Leadership asked for a 2-line exec note on risk for Private on-prem. I can draft.

Maya Patel: Thanks Priya 44aa. Also need a 1-paragraph FAQ for Sales covering SLAs and onboarding time. Who can take?

Dan Wu: I can draft the SLA/onboarding paragraph and drop it into the Confluence page linked below.

SRE Oncall: For the canary rollout question: confirm target SLOs please so we can set alerts.

Maya Patel: Canary SLOs: p95 <= 220ms, error rate < 0.5%. Ops: temporary early-warning alert at p95 >= 180ms or error_rate >= 0.3%.

ops-bot: Attached SLA snippet and scheduled reminder for owners (Mon 07:30 PT).

- Priya: exec risk blurb + one-pager about compliance (ETA Tue EOD)
- Dan: SLA/onboarding FAQ paragraph (ETA Tue noon)
